summary.headline: Solex Q1 FY27 revenue rose 1.8% YoY to INR265.6 crore while PAT fell to INR8.3 crore (3.1% margin) on higher depreciation and finance costs.
summary.overview: Q1 FY27 revenue was INR265.6 crore, up 1.8% YoY from INR261 crore, but EBITDA fell to INR33.8 crore (12.7% margin vs 16.4%). Depreciation rose to INR10.2 crore and finance cost to INR12.5 crore, taking PAT to INR8.3 crore (3.1% margin). Management attributed the weak quarter to seasonality, ALMM-2 (ALCM) timing shifts that delayed module off-take, and full-quarter costs of the 4 GW capacity, and reiterated FY27 guidance of a 5-6% PAT margin with an H2-weighted year. Management also flagged progress on a 2.2 GW cell line, with funding and land still pending.

segments.name: Module manufacturing (4 GW, Tadkeshwar, Gujarat)
segments.commentary: Four module lines operating; lines 3 and 4 commissioned November 2025 and reached full utilisation by March 2026. FY27 average utilisation assumed at about 55%, versus about 70% in FY26 per an analyst question.

segments.name: EPC
segments.commentary: Not a focus; management targets INR100-150 crore of EPC business at a 10-12% margin, mainly C&I projects of 1-5 MW and rooftop. Government EPC revenue booked in Q1 FY26 was not repeated.

guidance_outlook: FY27 revenue guidance and PAT margin of 5-6% reiterated.
FY27 module utilisation assumed at about 55% on average across the year.
Executable order pipeline of INR845.84 crore (INR628+ crore order from July, INR42.47 crore order from August, INR175 crore LOI with MSA at signing stage) targeted for execution by December 31, 2026.
2.2 GW N-type TOPCon+ cell line on track for commissioning by end of calendar 2027.
Vision 2030: 10 GW module, 10 GW cell, 10 GW BESS and 2 GW wafer/ingot capacity; INR4,000 crore MoU with Government of Gujarat.
Module capex reduced: planned 2.5 GW module line dropped; cell project cost now about INR1,050 crore (INR700 crore debt, INR350 crore equity via NCDs/CCDs).
capex_capacity: Module capacity 4 GW at Tadkeshwar, Gujarat; lines 3 and 4 commissioned November 2025.
2.2 GW cell line (phase 1 of 5 GW single-site cell plan; phase 2 of 3 GW). Commissioning targeted by end CY2027.

Cell project cost about INR1,050 crore: debt of about INR700 crore at advanced discussion with lender; equity of INR350 crore via NCDs/CCDs in due diligence. QIP/preferential route abandoned due to market conditions.
Land: parcel procured per management; 30 MW power connection in Gujarat has verbal approval, written approval awaited.
Cell technology partner and KPI-linked operator being onboarded for line design, commissioning and operations.
BESS: containerised manufacturing setup under evaluation with technology partners; to sit in a separate subsidiary. No timeline given beyond 'coming quarters'.
demand_pricing: Order book approximately INR3,400 crore (per management), across confirmed POs, signed MSAs awaiting POs, and advanced-stage MSAs; management says visibility is not contingent on ALMM-2 outcome.
ALMM-2 (ALCM) on cells: no extension announced on 25 May 2026, causing project holds and customer-driven delivery rescheduling in Q1 and Q2. Management calls these timing shifts, not cancellations.
Management estimated about 20% of orders have vulnerability from the captive/DCR segment; said this was resolved by the government's selective extension to December 2026 for commissioning.

Domestic DCR cell supply constrained: three Indian cell makers supply small volumes; one partner to supply 1 GW per year after ramp-up; total about 2.5 GW per year of G12R cells expected from MoU partners.
Export focus: Europe, Middle East, Africa, with US market being tested; FY27 export revenue projected to be low.
OEM/contract manufacturing for global brands under discussion; two global top-five brands already served; Q4 FY27 targeted for Indian projects.
Customer concentration: largest closed order above INR600 crore; second INR175 crore; third INR42 crore.
